> 第15章 天赋测试前（第1页）
姬云生又写道：“姐姐，好了，以后我会陪着你去寻找答案的。”陈晓云看完后，笑着说道：“弟弟，有你这么一个弟弟真好。”洛冰儿见两人不理她，顿时有些气愤说道：“晓云，都这么晚了，难道还不让小弟弟回去休息吗？就他这半岁孩童，你难道不知道这些吗？”
姬云生见状写道：“那个，我其实并不困，我也不知道为什么，反正就类似你们修炼者一般，就算不睡觉休息，我都不会觉得精神不好。”洛冰儿看了看说道：“让你回去睡觉就回去睡觉，这事又不是我不知道。时间不早了，明天记得早点来主峰测试。”
然后就带着莫名的气愤离开了，姬云生也是无语了，写道：“晓云姐，你师尊这是什么臭脾气啊？我们又没有招惹她，她生气是什么鬼？”陈晓云看完，温柔笑着无奈回答道：“我也不知道，师尊又不说，你问姐姐我也没有答案告诉你，要不是因为你，
我连师尊叫什么都不知道呢！”姬云生听完写道：“那好吧，你师尊真是奇怪了。”陈晓云温柔笑着说道：“弟弟，时间也不早了，还是听师尊的赶紧休息吧！明早姐姐在带你去测试天赋。”姬云生一听点点头，也回去自己的房间休息了，陈晓云见状也去修炼室修炼去了。
然而这时回到房间的洛冰儿，生气的说道：“两个不让人省心的小家伙，早晚要把我气死。不过这小弟弟倒是挺有意思的，要不等他测试完后，我向外宣布他是我的亲传弟子好了？这样一来的话，早晚都能教训这臭小子，居然敢如此威胁本小姐，真是好大的胆子啊。
不过他说的倒是有可能是真的，我刚见他时，居然看不出他的任何信息，真是奇了怪了。说不定，要是我真的搜魂查看的话，那因果之力的反噬，肯定不是一般的大。不过应该不会如此夸张，最多就只是让我受重伤而已，毕竟好歹我也是个渡劫初期的修士，
反噬之力应该不至于那么严重。算了算了，这样做也不好，等到这臭小子什么时候愿意说了，在知道我想知道的吧。毕竟那样来说，才是最稳妥的方法，既不用担心受伤，也能知道自己想知道的答案。不过这事还是需要一步步来，先取的这臭小子的信任，
那就先从明天的收徒开始吧，嘻嘻！”然后就收敛心思，洗漱过后就躺下休息了。天一亮，等到姬云生缓缓睁开双眼后，一张绝美的脸蛋出现在他眼前，这可把他吓了一跳，顿时完全清醒过来了。着急忙慌的仔细查看起眼前之人，确认过后才舒口气，拿出纸笔写道：“
姐姐，你这大早上的吓我一跳，我还以家里进贼了呢。”陈晓云一听满脸不乐意，有些生气问道：“弟弟，你这么说是怪姐姐了？就这么怕看到姐姐？难道姐姐是长得很丑吗？居然让你如此之大的反应。”姬云生一听，连忙写道：“姐姐，我没有觉得你丑，
反之你很美，但是谁在睡醒时，意识还没有清醒，本人如此近距离看着，不会被吓一跳。我可是没有修为的凡人，可是察觉不到这种情况，这可不能怪我有这样的反应了。”陈晓云一听顿时笑了起来，温柔笑着说道：“弟弟，赶紧起床洗漱，姐姐带你去找师尊测试天赋。”
姬云生一听，也起身开始去洗漱了，短短几分钟就洗漱好了，回来后写字问道：“姐姐，厕所在哪里，我想上厕所。”陈晓云一听愣了下，带着歉意温柔回答道：“弟弟，对不起，我这就带你去，我都忘了把这事告诉你了。”然后抱起姬云生就往厕所而去，
主要是怕他憋不住，以她的修为带着他去的话，短短几秒后就能抵达。到了地方后，这才放下他温柔笑着说道：“弟弟，赶紧去吧，里面有厕纸的。完事过后，姐姐带你去测试天赋，姐姐就在外面等你。”姬云生一听，也顾不得回答了，连忙跑进厕所解决大小便问题了。

> Chapter 15 Before the Talent Test (Page 1)
Ji Yunsheng wrote again: "Sister, okay, I will accompany you to find the answer in the future." After reading, Chen Xiaoyun said with a smile: "Brother, it's great to have a brother like you." Seeing the two people ignoring her, Luo Bing'er suddenly became angry and said: "Xiaoyun, it's so late, why don't you let your little brother go back to rest? He's only half a year old, don't you know this?"
Upon seeing this, Ji Yunsheng wrote: "Well, I'm actually not sleepy. I don't know why. Anyway, just like you cultivators, I won't feel out of shape even if I don't sleep." Luo Bing'er looked at it and said, "Go back to sleep when I tell you to. It's not that I don't know about it. It's getting late. Remember to come to the main peak early tomorrow for the test."
Then he left with inexplicable anger. Ji Yunsheng was also speechless and wrote: "Sister Xiaoyun, what kind of bad temper does your master have? We didn't provoke her, why is she angry?" Chen Xiaoyun read it, smiled softly and replied helplessly: "I don't know, master didn't tell me, if you ask sister, I don't have the answer to tell you, if it weren't for you,
I don’t even know what Master’s name is! After hearing this, Ji Yunsheng wrote: "Well, your master is really strange." Chen Xiaoyun said with a gentle smile: "Brother, it's getting late. It's better to listen to Master and rest quickly!" My sister will take you to test your talent tomorrow morning. "Ji Yunsheng nodded when he heard this and went back to his room to rest. Upon seeing this, Chen Xiaoyun also went to the training room to practice.
However, Luo Bing'er, who returned to the room at this time, said angrily: "These two troublesome little guys are going to piss me off sooner or later. But this little brother is quite interesting. How about I announce to the public that he is my direct disciple after he finishes the test? In this way, sooner or later, I can teach this brat a lesson. How dare you threaten me like this? How brave you are."
But what he said may be true. When I first met him, I couldn't find any information about him. It was really strange. Maybe, if I really search the soul to check, the backlash of the power of cause and effect will definitely not be as big as usual. But it shouldn’t be such an exaggeration. At most, it would only cause me serious injuries. After all, I am also a monk in the early stage of transcending tribulation.
The backlash shouldn't be that serious. Forget it, it's not good to do this. When this brat is willing to talk, he will know what I want to know. After all, that is the safest way. You don't have to worry about getting hurt, and you can still know the answer you want to know. However, this matter still needs to be done step by step, first gaining the trust of this brat,
Then let’s start with recruiting disciples tomorrow, hee hee! "Then he gathered his thoughts, washed up, and lay down to rest. At dawn, when Ji Yunsheng slowly opened his eyes, a beautiful face appeared in front of him, which shocked him, and he suddenly woke up completely. He hurriedly checked the person in front of him carefully. After confirming, he breathed a sigh of relief, took out a pen and paper and wrote: "
Sister, you scared me so early in the morning that I thought there was a burglar in the house. Chen Xiaoyun looked unhappy when he heard this, and asked angrily: "Brother, are you blaming your sister for saying this?" Are you so afraid of seeing your sister? Is my sister ugly? To think you had such a big reaction. When Ji Yunsheng heard this, he quickly wrote: "Sister, I don't think you are ugly.
On the contrary, you are very beautiful, but when someone wakes up from sleep, his consciousness is not yet awake. I will not be shocked if I look at you from such a close distance. I am a mortal with no cultivation, but I am not aware of this situation. You can't blame me for reacting like this. "Chen Xiaoyun immediately laughed when he heard this, smiling softlySaid: "Brother, get up and wash up quickly. Sister will take you to the master to test your talent."
When Ji Yunsheng heard this, he got up and started to wash up. He finished washing up in just a few minutes. When he came back, he wrote and asked, "Sister, where is the toilet? I want to go to the toilet." Chen Xiaoyun was stunned for a moment, and replied softly and apologetically: "Brother, I'm sorry, I'll take you there right now. I even forgot to tell you this." Then he picked up Ji Yunsheng and went to the toilet.
Mainly because she was afraid that he wouldn't be able to hold it in. If she took him with her, she would arrive in just a few seconds. After arriving at the place, he put him down and said with a gentle smile: "Brother, go quickly, there is toilet paper inside. After you are done, sister will take you to test your talent. Sister will be waiting for you outside." When Ji Yunsheng heard this, he didn't care to answer, and ran into the toilet to solve the problem of defecation and defecation.
